description: This PHP class 'MyInfoMenuConfigurator' implements the 'MenuConfigurator' interface to configure menu items for the 'My Info' section in the orangehrmPimPlugin. It uses the MenuServiceTrait to access menu-related services and retrieves a specific menu item by its title.

classes.name: MyInfoMenuConfigurator
classes.description: Implements menu configuration to fetch the 'My Info' menu item for the user interface.

methods.name: configure
methods.description: Retrieves the 'My Info' menu item with a specified priority from the menu service.
